changelog: v10.11.0: Concept framing per direction — describe the MAXIMUM vision with a clear 'concept in development' disclaimer and an invite for interested users + developers to get in touch by email. Homepage Concept section, site-wide footer disclaimer, and App Store en-US/de-DE description + release notes now lead with the concept disclaimer + contact.

v10.11.0: TestFlight readiness — clean-URL pages so App Store privacy_url (/privacy) and support_url (/support) resolve (were 404 on GitHub Pages); fixed release-notes email to echoel@tropicaldrones.com; added a Beta/early-access section to the homepage (iOS 18 + iPhone, request access, feedback).
v10.11.0: Replaced the term 'binaural' with 'head-tracked spatial audio' (avoids the purged pseudoscience term; clearer).
v10.11.0: Homepage tightened — removed two redundant audience cards (Education/Research, Game Developers) already covered by the Editions section.
v10.11.0: Pro polish — og:image dimensions on all subpages, refreshed sitemap dates, consistent em-dash page titles.
v10.11.0: Unified contact email to echoel@tropicaldrones.com across every page (display, mailto, and structured-data contactPoint).
v10.11.0: Whole logo button (mark + ECHOELMUSIC text) now links home — removed pointer-events:none. Artist section added to the homepage (bio, links, full-page CTA). Cache + asset version bumped.

v10.11.0: Added Planned/roadmap tags across vision pages (Tools, Overview) marking unbuilt features (EchoelLux/Stage/AI, face tracking, AR/Generative Worlds, EchoelBeat/Breakbeat, NLE/ProRes, analog comps). Reframed heart rate: tempo is an optional adopt, not forced — bio mainly modulates the parameters you paint. New FAQ: features available at launch vs. roadmap. Fixed platform overclaim, removed emoji, fps/lang consistency.

v10.11.0: Added a complete Formats & Standards section (Overview) and Formats & I/O (Architecture) covering spatial audio (stereo today; Atmos/3D/ambisonics/head-tracked planned), audio (WAV/AAC/CAF + LUFS), MIDI 2.0/MPE, video (H.264 MP4 today; H.265/ProRes/4K planned), visuals & projection mapping (NDI/Syphon/AirPlay), lighting (DMX-512/Art-Net/HomeKit) and streaming (RTMP). Added Spatial Audio capability to EchoelFX.

v10.5.0: Deepest codebase audit (4 parallel agents, file-level): rebuilt Architecture page with a dedicated Multidimensional/MPE section (MIDI 2.0, per-note pitch bend, slide/timbre CC74, air-CC), a working AUv3-generator section (8 automatable params, factory presets), exact synthesis detail (DDSP noise colours/spectral shapes, 8 Cellular rules, 8 Modal materials), real effects (convolution reverb, 4-band EQ, LUFS, SVF), 5 Metal visual modes + chroma key, short-form video export, and LIVE/ROADMAP tags throughout (DMX/Stage/AI/Ableton Link/ProRes marked roadmap honestly).

v10.4.0: Added developer-grade Architecture page (EngineBus signal chain, SPSC data plane, bio-DSP triad, synthesis engines, OSC API, concurrency, performance, module map, honest implementation status) grounded in a deep codebase audit. Normalized navigation + complete footer (12 links) across every page; fixed Artist footer. 'Architecture' added to menu and sitemap.
v10.3.0: Restored full product site (12-engine EchoelToolkit + complete menu) combined with the Echoel artist page. App CTAs replaced with 'Coming Soon' (app not yet released). English.
v10.2.1: Fix hero content invisible with Reduce Motion (prefers-reduced-motion). All animated elements now get explicit opacity:1 fallback. SW cache bump to v10.2.1.

v10.2.1: Website aligned with actual codebase — 12 tools (EchoelSynth, EchoelFX, EchoelMix, EchoelSeq, EchoelMIDI, EchoelBio, EchoelVis, EchoelVid, EchoelLux, EchoelStage, EchoelNet, EchoelAI). Removed non-existent features from website. EngineBus → EchoelCreativeWorkspace.
v10.2.0: Generative Worlds + AR Worlds (EchoelVis), 3 Editions (Creative Suite, Research, SDK), 8 audience personas (was 4). EchoelToolkit.swift central reference.
v10.1.0: Fix stale '25 tools' references → 12 unified tools across manifest.json, version.json. Bump cache version, update build date.

v10.0.0: Engines consolidated into 12 unified Echoel* tools — EchoelSynth, EchoelFX, EchoelMix, EchoelSeq, EchoelMIDI, EchoelBio, EchoelVis, EchoelVid, EchoelLux, EchoelStage, EchoelNet, EchoelAI. OSC + Ableton Link networking.
v9.2.0: EchoelStage — external displays, AirPlay, projection, multi-screen, audience view.

v9.1.0: Enhanced DDSP (12 bio-mappings, spectral morphing, timbre transfer), Rausch-inspired bio-signal algorithms (BioEventGraph, HilbertSensorMapper, BioSignalDeconvolver), BioSignalDSP integrated into EchoelBio + EchoelVis, extended BioSnapshot, 56 test suites

v9.0.0: EchoelToolkit — consolidated into 12 unified Echoel* tools (EchoelSynth, EchoelFX, EchoelMix, EchoelSeq, EchoelMIDI, EchoelBio, EchoelVis, EchoelVid, EchoelLux, EchoelStage, EchoelNet, EchoelAI). Card-based tools section, updated specs and FAQ.
